To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the majority of Ukrainian MSM are interested in PrEP and would prefer to use it in a form of a pill, but only a few of them would be willing to use PrEP if it is too expensive or requires a lot of time and effort to obtain.

(1) Ukrainian MSM have strong preference for PrEP, but only if it is affordable and provided in the most convenient manner possible; (2) the most effective PrEP delivery programs are those that target at-risk MSM and provide them with comprehensive medical care; and (3) Ukrainian MSM are most interested in PrEP delivery programs that provide them with the most convenient and least burdensome PrEP regimen.

1) PrEP affordability is a key factor for MSM in Ukraine, 2) daily PrEP dosing is not preferred among Ukrainian MSM, 3) ‘on-demand’ PrEP is the most preferred PrEP dosing strategy, 4) PrEP uptake is most likely to succeed when PrEP implementation is targeted to at-risk populations and provided with medical care and related services.
